Name: Warner Bros Discovery Inc
Description: Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. (WBD) is a leading global media and entertainment company headquartered in New York, New York, formed through the merger of WarnerMedia and Discovery, Inc. The company operates a diverse portfolio of well-known brands and franchises, delivering compelling content across multiple platforms, including television, film, and streaming services. WBD is strategically positioned to leverage its extensive content library and innovative digital offerings to meet the evolving demands of audiences worldwide, enhancing its competitive edge in the rapidly changing media landscape. With a focus on premium storytelling and audience engagement, Warner Bros. Discovery aims to drive long-term growth and shareholder value.
Address: 230 PARK AVENUE SOUTH, NEW YORK, NY, UNITED STATES, 10003
